WITH ordered_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        c.customer_unique_id,
        o.order_purchase_timestamp,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.customer_unique_id ORDER BY o.order_purchase_timestamp) as rn
    FROM orders o
    JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
),
filtered_customers AS (
    SELECT customer_unique_id
    FROM ordered_orders
    GROUP BY customer_unique_id
    HAVING MAX(rn) >= 2
),
first_two AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_unique_id,
        MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN order_purchase_timestamp END) as t1,
        MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 2 THEN order_purchase_timestamp END) as t2
    FROM ordered_orders
    WHERE rn <= 2 AND customer_unique_id IN (SELECT customer_unique_id FROM filtered_customers)
    GROUP BY customer_unique_id
)
SELECT 
    AVG(julianday(t2) - julianday(t1)) AS avg_days
FROM first_two;
